description: Inspects .stop() calls flagged by THREAD_STOP_DISABLED for actual Thread.stop() usage. Most calls are custom .stop() methods in JADE's own classes (Timer.stop(), client.stop(), HTTPServer.stop()), not java.lang.Thread.stop(Throwable). Marks false positives as SKIPPED.
